purpose: Build, measure and evolve Autonomously Self-Improving Factories: maintain the ASIF template and rulebook that any repository can adopt, and consult member factories on their process health, cadence and autonomy.

owns: the template instrument surface — methodology, development and cross-member deployment (owner-commissioned 2026-09-27)
the ASIF template and rulebook (TEMPLATE/ and the derived laws)
member-factory surveys, scores and the measurement cadence
does_not_own: member factories' products, backlogs, repos and code
member factories' ontologies and issue boards
the OpenCrabs runtime, daemon and core tools - a client-supplier loop, not ownership
token provisioning, model routing and inference pricing (InferHub Watch)

announcements.text:
Pacemaker cron triggers on this box still pass `--mode quiet` for a set of jobs, NONE of them meta-factory's: the original three are `ai-antispam-owner-digest` and `ai-antispam-triage-sweep` (ai-antispam, both ENABLED), and `oc-triage-owner-digest` (opencrabs-dev, now DISABLED) — but the quiet population stands well past them. The owner re-ruling of 2026-09-19T03:34:30Z / 03:36:54Z made turn-end THE default for all lane traffic and retained quiet only for batch/fan-out notices whose ack contract is the ledger; a single-lane pacemaker is not batch/fan-out, so each of these defers instead of waking an idle lane immediately. Meta-factory's jobs were moved to explicit `--mode turn-end` on 2026-09-23 (byte-verified; schedule and next_run_at preserved): of its NINE `factory-*` jobs, FIVE carry it (`factory-measurement-daily`, `factory-triage-patrol`, `factory-insights-weekly`, `factory-template-weekly`, `factory-growth-map-biweekly`) and FOUR carry none (`factory-hq-pacemaker`, `factory-publish`, `factory-questions-redeliver`, `factory-registry-attest`). Infra-factory's four now read plain `--mode turn-end` with no cap flags, so the pattern is demonstrated by a second factory rather than asserted. CAUTION FOR WHOEVER FIXES THE REMAINING ONES — the cap flag cannot be dropped alone: each carries `--mode quiet --quiet-for-secs 20 --max-delay-secs 30`, and its prompt documents WHY the cap is there, namely that quiet's DEFAULT starvation cap of 1800s blocks past the tool's 120s budget and kills the trigger. That hazard is quiet-specific and vanishes under turn-end, so the mode and the cap move TOGETHER and the sentence justifying the cap must be rewritten with them, or the prompt ends up arguing for a flag it no longer carries.

Live census 2026-10-16T06:48:55Z (ops home): of 67 cron rows, 25 carry `--mode` — 9 turn-end rows, 16 quiet rows (one quiet row disabled — `oc-triage-owner-digest`; 13 ai-antispam jobs carry it; `inferhub-daily-report` remains a SECOND factory's job). THE QUIET POPULATION IS NO LONGER FLAT: quiet went 15 → 16 and the table total 66 → 67 on ONE new row, `ai-antispam-118-probe` (enabled=0, `--mode quiet`, created 2026-10-16T00:42:42) — a DISABLED row, so it grows the population while leaving the enabled count untouched (ops stays 33 enabled). The three prior readings (2026-10-13, 2026-10-11, 2026-10-10) all read 24 — 9/15 and were called flat; that description is now FALSIFIED, and the standing claim is only that the series is appended to, never overwritten.

SCOPE CORRECTION, and read it with the census above: the series is an OPS-HOME read, while this entry's own opening sentence is a claim about the BOX — those are not the same population, and the box-wide read is LARGER. At the same instant three homes hold a `cron_jobs` table — default 11 rows (8 enabled), family 2 (1 enabled), ops 67 (33 enabled) = **80 rows, 42 enabled** — so a reader who checks the box sees 80 rows where the series names 67. The 25/9/16 figure is the one comparable across the series; 80 is the box. Neither is derived from the other, and the entry no longer states a box claim off a profile-scoped reader.

Prior censuses kept as the steps this one follows, never overwritten: 2026-10-15T06:56:37Z of 66 rows, 24 — 9/15; 2026-10-13T06:07:35Z of 66 rows, 24 — 9/15; 2026-10-11T06:09:42Z of 68 rows, 24 — 9/15; 2026-10-10T06:05:09Z of 68 rows, 24 — 9/15; 2026-10-09T06:05:50Z of 68 rows, 26 — 9/17; 2026-10-06T06:09Z of 67 rows, 26 — 9/17; 2026-10-05T06:19Z of 67 rows, 25 — 9/16; 2026-10-04T06:29:35Z of 66 rows, 12 — 9/3; 2026-10-02T06:19Z of 66 rows, 12 — 9/3; 2026-10-01T06:07Z of 65 rows, 12 — 9/3; 2026-09-29T08:26Z of 64, 12 — 9/3; 2026-09-28T11:35:19Z of 63, 12 — 9/3; 2026-09-26T06:20Z of 57, 12 — 9/3; 2026-09-23T11:31Z of 55, 13 — 10/3.

announcements.text:
Brain metrics are a STANDING reading with an instrument: tools/brain_metrics.py (no args needed; --home / --hours / --log-dir / --window) prints all three legs with their predicate, population and instant, and gates none of them. The clause that binds it is docs/measurement-procedure.md section 5; its gate is tests/test_brain_metrics.py. A figure in this notice is a DATED READING and never current — run the instrument.

LEG C — CORRECTED 2026-10-01; the earlier wording is SUPERSEDED, not repeated. The earlier text claimed the automatic threshold trigger was DORMANT, having "fired 0 times since the 1M window". That is FALSE on this box today, measured two ways in one turn: (a) the trigger line itself — "Context at NN% (>65%) — triggering LLM compaction", emitted at src/brain/agent/service/compaction.rs:445/460 (the earlier text cited :418; the line moved) — fired 525 times across 20 distinct sessions in the 2026-10-01 log, this lane's session among them, and this lane was compacted mid-loop today; (b) the instrument's LEG C, which parses the DIFFERENT summarizer line at context.rs, read n=159 events in its 24h window — mean 73022 tok = 36.5% of a 200000-token window, median 79677, p90 114738, max 156319. The trigger line's denominator is NOT the provider window: it is effective tokens over effective max (the window minus reserves), so the earlier notice's equation "the 65-percent gate = 650000 tokens" conflates two denominators, which the instrument's own BOUNDS section 1 forbids. Never read a trigger-line percentage as a fraction of the provider window.

CONSEQUENCES the earlier text got backwards: (a) the note pipeline is NOT starved — save_compaction_summary_to_memory is the sole writer of memory/<date>.md, and with 159 summarizer sends in 24h a note exists for any day lanes are active, so memory_search's default scope is supplied rather than blind; (b) a count of compaction events tracks how many lanes were awake and how many turns they ran, never the weight of the law.

TWO CORRECTIONS worth keeping from the earlier text, both category errors: (a) the "110423 / 1000000 input tokens" line reports the SUMMARIZER'S PAYLOAD against its own input budget (context.rs), which is NOT the trigger's reading; (b) FullWindow is a CompactionScope (WHAT gets compacted), not a trigger KIND.

LATEST READING 2026-10-15T06:55:29Z — this block SUPERSEDES the 2026-10-01 reading that stood here, and the earlier one is not repeated: LEG A, the always-injected Tier 0 triple (SOUL.md, USER.md, AGENTS.md; in no repository, so a leg-A reading has an INSTANT for its identity and no revision) 187 lines / 43615 B / ~12461 tok (proxy) = 6.23% of a 200000-token window — UP from 186 / 33598 / ~9599 tok = 4.80% at 2026-10-01, the growth sitting in AGENTS.md (130 lines / 38278 B, 69.52% of injected lines). LEG B, skills/*/SKILL.md (depth 1): 553 lines / 44091 B / ~12597 tok (proxy) = 6.30%, and its single file `skills/meta-factory/SKILL.md` is OVER the 500-line marker by 53 (printed, never gated). COMBINED = ~25058 tok (proxy) = 12.53% of a 200000-token window, against 16.88% at 2026-10-01 and 14.95% at 2026-09-19 — the combined figure FELL again even as leg A rose, because leg B's population is one file here and leg A's growth did not offset the earlier AGENTS.md shrink (458 lines / 144957 B → 130 lines / 38278 B); the floor is not monotonically rising. LEG C as of this reading: n=434 events in the 24h window, mean 9993 tok = 5.0%, median 3328 = 1.7%, p90 33748 = 16.9%, min 413, max 97002 — and the count is a property of its window (how many lanes were awake), never of the law's weight.

open-questions.reason: Source repo: this factory IS the instrument's canonical home, so local adoption is not an act it can take, and tools/instrument_census.py reports it as SOURCE and excludes it from adoption counting -- counting the source as its own adopter inflates every wave by one. behind_by is null because the axis does not apply: the declared set IS this tree's own, so there is no template half to lag. Measured note for a reader who runs the member-root predicate anyway: this repo holds 2 of the 4 at those paths (tests/test_questions.py and the law doc) and none of the tool or its render asset, because the source ships them under TEMPLATE/ -- that is a layout artifact, not drift, and it is why a 0 here would invite a comparison the reader would then measure as 2/4. Recorded by the Open Questions instrument lane on the owner's order 2026-09-29.
